title: Exact manual fulfillment approval evidence
purpose: Represent one immutable caller-supplied positive approval assertion for the exact fulfillment terms of one exact FOOD-005E physical-order version, including an explicitly approved additional fulfillment fee, without calculating service area or creating checkout/payment authority.
whyNow: Canonical business direction requires manual approval for outside-area requests before charging.
The outside-area flow is request -> review route/location/time/cost -> approve fee/window -> payment link -> paid confirmation.
No canonical manual service-area, route, fee or window approval record currently exists.
A generic checkout/payment-readiness projection would be premature if it could not prove that required manual fulfillment approval occurred.

contract.identity: Caller-supplied food-manual-fulfillment-approval identity. Initial version is exactly 1. No revision family in this slice.
contract.orderBinding: Bind one exact FOOD-005E physical-order ID/version.
contract.fulfillmentBinding: Bind the exact FOOD-005D fulfillment-intent ID/version referenced by that physical-order version and copy exact method, locationReference and windowReference.
contract.fee: approvedAdditionalFee is explicit FoodMoney and must use the same currency as the exact physical-order merchandise subtotal. Zero is permitted. It is approval evidence only, not a final payable assessment.
contract.approval: Caller supplies attribution, opaque sourceReference and approvedOn. Pure domain does not authenticate the approver or source.
contract.historicalCancellation: An approval assertion may be retained against an exact cancelled physical-order version as historical evidence; it does not revive the order.
contract.immutability: Strict own-key allowlists; detached frozen result and nested snapshots.
contract.purity: No clock, network, geocoding, radius calculation, database, filesystem, provider, route optimization or persistence.

boundaries: manual fulfillment approval != final payable assessment
historical approval on cancelled order != order revival
deferred: proof that an approved fee is included in a payable assessment

future.payableAssessment: A later trusted service may use the explicit approvedAdditionalFee as upstream authority for an exact FOOD-005J charge adjustment. FOOD-005M itself does not mutate or validate an assessment.
future.readiness: A later readiness slice must preserve the distinction between standard-policy eligibility and requests requiring manual approval, and must not create provider checkout unless all required authorities are satisfied.
